name: messy-blonde-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: hair, makeup table, vanity light, and night selfie reference

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic nighttime vanity mirror selfie of an approved adult woman midway through makeup.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult platinum-blonde woman with messy volume waves and light grey-blue eyes, wearing a fully buttoned oversized white shirt over an opaque black top, holding a makeup brush and smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:3 raw iPhone mirror selfie with vanity bulbs, makeup scattered across the table, open palettes, lipsticks, softly blurred messy bedroom, playful bored expression, optional non-text tattoo omitted.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft vanity-bulb glow, gentle night shadows, chaotic half-ready glam atmosphere, light realistic noise.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, 4:3, 24mm look, natural skin texture, accurate reflection, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult platinum-blonde woman with messy waves takes a night vanity mirror selfie while holding a makeup brush and phone, wearing a fully buttoned oversized white shirt over an opaque black top. Include vanity bulbs, makeup palettes, lipsticks, messy bedroom, soft glam glow, natural texture, and candid boredom. No exposed chest or tattoo text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, open shirt, exposed chest, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, readable tattoo text, brand makeup text, distorted mirror, watermark, public figure likeness.
